QuestInfo.name: The Eccentric Blackbull
QuestInfo.0: Ayan doesn't look so good. She told you to go see someone in Perion...but didn't tell you who. Ask her again.
QuestInfo.1: Oh...it was Blackbull. Ayan advised bringing him some Leaves when you meet him. Collect some Leaves and take them to Blackbull.
QuestInfo.2: You visited Blackbull, and gave him nome nice Leaves.

0.0: Have you spoken to Blackbull yet? He was fussing about you not introducing yourself earlier. He's a huge pain, but part of life in Perion is dealing with annoyances like that...

yes.0: If you're going to see him, you might as well bring him a gift. I suggest some Leaves from the Dark Stumps. Blackbull likes to make salads with them. He's an odd one. 10 should be plenty to get on his good side.
yes.1: You can find Dark Stumps at the #m102020100#.

no.0: #h0#, I think you should go say hello to Blackbull...both for your own good (she cracks her knuckles) and for the town's peace...

1.0: Oh, finally decided to show up, did you? And don't tell me you came empty handed!

yes.0: Now we're talkin'. These Leaves will make me a fine salad. Stick around, and maybe I'll throw you the scraps! Ha!

npc.0: Why are you still here? I told you to talk to Blackbull. Do I look like Blackbull? Answer CAREFULLY.

item.0: Another useless bum... Don't you know I like Leaves? Bring me 10, and maybe I'll feel like talking to you.
